rawContent: I watched “The hate you give” on the plane the other day. Today I was pulled over by a state trooper ( yeah,speeding). Not for one second did I worry about getting shot. All I worried about was getting a ticket ( didn’t get one). Yes, #blacklivesmatter . And #takingtheknee helps

I got pulled over for speeding today. I never feared for my life, only worried ab. getting a ticket.Also, the state trooper who pulled me over was a black man. I doubt very much any black person would feel the same way were the police officer white. Just saying #blacklivesmatter
